description: A derelict forge: a cold metal housing still holding a residual lava pool, two broken support pillars (one snapped), a slag pile. Reads as 'someone was smelting down here, long ago'. 20x12px.
notes: depth_band is negative-of-(DEPTH-...): interpreted by the loader as 'measured up from the world floor' for the deep category, see README. Real LAVA left in the housing (finding: water/lava as static-but-real props) rather than an inert orange fill, so it still emits real heat/light and is a genuine hazard to touch.
